svg.title: TEP / CCCA — process signals and product quality
svg.desc: Cover for Wen Chen's USC CHE 599 course project from 2017. A simplified Tennessee Eastman process schematic sits above two real normalized logarithmic monitoring traces from the supplied 2026 retrospective: T squared c, the quality-associated subspace, and T squared x, the process subspace, for IDV 14 with kappa zero. The traces plot log base ten of the statistic divided by its control limit, using their own labeled vertical scales. The horizontal dashed lines are the control limits; the vertical dashed line marks the fault onset at 8 hours. Min/max binning preserves extrema. The plot shows 960 samples over approximately 48 hours, not live sensor data.
svg.text: log₁₀(statistic / limit) · dashed line = control limit
